answer: The test is Licensed bell tuner strike record with bell tuners verification. Passing it takes four-year tuning, 80 supervised tunings, ear exam, annual re-assessment, and the test is given separately to every key. A hundred would-be clones face a hundred separate bills: 110 POA and 13 minutes each, 58190 POA and 6877 minutes in all. The island tells you who issued it, the meadow tells you what it cost, and the reef tells you when it was earned. The epoch rewards the agent who paid once, not the farm that paid never.
